name: Swarm Raiders
summary:
The garden is huge. Your bugs are ready.

Play as an Apelien and launch from The Ark into a giant garden full of wild creatures, hidden Crates, valuable resources, and powerful bosses. Choose your Buggo, mount up, and take the fight to the skies!

**🐞BUILD YOUR BATTLE BUGGO**

Find Crates and collect Wild Gear from the world. Equip Battle Gear on your Buggo’s Gear Mounts to create a battle mount that fits your playstyle. Every loadout can change the way you fight.
